extraction_method: Direct extraction of reported Table 9 ΔTP, ΔRecall (pp) and ΔAP rows; fresh full-cell verification of Table 10 against run01 before copying. Reported decimal precision retained.

metadata.LightGBM: Mean of five paired seed effects
metadata.Logistic: One fixed converged fit per condition
metadata.resampling: Existing paired moving-block draws; workflow differences use the same shared draws
metadata.interval_conditions: Fixed fitted workflows and observed windows
metadata.direct_difference: Logistic component effect minus LightGBM component effect; interval from the directly paired draw series
metadata.preprocessing: Different across workflows; comparison does not isolate an algorithm-family effect
metadata.absolute_performance_boundary: Logistic absolute AP and capture remain lower in all 12 IEEE-CIS conditions; absolute outcomes retained in Table S24
metadata.point_decomposition_boundary: M1-M0 plus M2-M1 equals M2-M0 only as the point-estimate path identity; CI endpoints are not added or subtracted

combined_metrics.ΔAP: AP difference on 0-1 scale; Table 9 original values

metadata.cost: Cost reduction remains in source Table 9 and is not exported for this figure
metadata.scale_boundary: AP, Recall and ΔTP are separate estimands and units; do not put them on a common numeric colour or position scale
metadata.interval_derivation_boundary: All combined intervals are taken directly from Table 9; no AP or Recall intervals are generated from other values

source_precision: Reported decimal precision from Tables 9 and 10; original experimental higher-precision records remain in the historical aggregate archives.
